messages:
pagerbot: ALERT: Ingest rate high on staging-infer-ws. 5000 req/min, 2xx->5xx ratio up. Link: https://ops/alerts/1751239876
olivia: seeing it, pulling logs now
sam: +1. staging-infer-ws started spiking at 02:43 UTC. Likely external replay against websocket endpoints
miguel: logs show repeated requests with header X-Client-Token: tzp_... that's a staging ephemeral token pattern
chloe: oh no, I see a public S3 put in the same timeframe to buckets/rdw-staging-exports, suspicious
olivia: paste log sample:
```
2026-03-18T02:43:11Z infer-ws id=abc123 src=54.36.12.9 headers={X-Client-Token: tzp_a1b2c3, User-Agent: curl/7.8}
2026-03-18T02:43:12Z export-job id=xyz789 action=put object=exports/2026-03-18/trace.log dest=s3://rdw-staging-exports/public.log
```
sam: that matches the honeytoken we seeded 2 weeks ago: `honey:stg-token-82` — check for that string in exports
security-team: jump in — can you confirm whether keys were exfil'd or a misconfigured exporter pushed logs?
olivia: running `aws s3api list-objects --bucket rdw-staging-exports --prefix exports/2026-03-18/` now
pagerbot: note: alert severity elevated to P1 due to potential leaked session tokens
miguel: found 3 files with `honey:stg-token-82` and partial headers, one file has IP 5.6.7.8 in file metadata
chloe: vendor ETL job has a deploy at 02:40 that changed ACL to public-read, submitting rollback
sam: mitigation plan: 1) revoke staging API keys that match the tzp_ prefix; 2) restrict staging S3 ACLs; 3) take suspected exports offline; 4) rotate any KMS keys used for staging artifacts
olivia: I rotated staging service account keys `staging-infer-sa` and disabled ingest for 10m. K8s job paused (deploy rollback queued)
miguel: I'm running a one-off scan for any `tzp_` tokens in our observability exports and code repos, also searching cloudtrail
security-team: confirm customer impact: this is only staging data with honeytokens; no production token patterns seen so far
chloe: rolling S3 ACL tighten now: `aws s3api put-bucket-acl --bucket rdw-staging-exports --acl private` — applied
sam: started key rotation script for staging API keys: `./scripts/rotate-keys --env=staging --pattern=tzp_*` -- ETA ~8m
olivia: handing off to night oncall @miguel — I need to sleep. Miguel, please continue triage and coordinate with security for KMS rotation if needed
miguel: ack, I'll continue. Next steps: confirm export file integrity, snapshot suspicious files, notify third-party ETL owner, and prepare customer impact note if we find any PII
security-team: keep me updated. If we detect any persistent exfil IPs, we'll file an IR and involve legal. Add any suspected external buckets to containment list
pagerbot: Pager duty note: escalation timeout at 1751239980
miguel: update: quarantined the three export files (copied to secure bucket rdw-secure-quarantine/) and removed public ACLs. continuing search; will post findings in ~15m
chloe: thanks all. I'll follow up with runbook link: https://internal/runbooks/staging-log-exfil
olivia: re-opening CI deploy checks to ensure no creds in artifacts, leaving the thread to oncall
